units: Dimensionless compartment amounts, model time, and amounts per model time; no calibration to plant units.

A_linear_circulation_and_stability.analytic_argument: A is Metzler and column i sums to -d_i. Column Gershgorin disks give Re(lambda)<=-min(d_i)<0. Hence x*=(-A)^-1 s is asymptotically stable; no autonomous sustained periodic solution occurs under constant s in this model.

E28_event_rule.construction: Each of nine events adds wait and then cells/p; repetition is explicitly supplied to the model.
E28_event_rule.interpretation: A complex eigenvalue describes a decaying mode, not a persistent clock. This result does not apply to the growing, spatial, nonlinear cell model of van den Berg et al.

B_fixed_collective_flux_and_molecular_re.interpretation: Each cohort starts in I and must pass T then O before returning. New supply contains none of that label. Total supply differs between conditions; no energy-work budget or chemical interconversion is modeled. Conditional return times exclude molecules that never return.

C_transport_sensitivity_of_imposed_gate.interpretation: This is the sensitivity of E28's imposed first-arrival gate plus growth wait. It is not an autonomous oscillation, a full circuit starting at I, or a rerun of the original growing-cell reflux model. Compare to original-paper mechanisms separately, without identifying the parameters numerically.

history_archive: histories.npz; rows follow time_model_units; named arrays distinguish analytic and ODE paths.
scope: Steady collective circulation, labeled molecular return, autonomous temporal oscillation, spatial toroidal geometry, and a universal generation principle are separate claims. Only the first three are compared in this specified linear model. Biological support and original-paper mechanism comparisons require separate evidence.
